evidence: Wikipedia's article on Taylor Swift: for '1989' (2014) she turned to 1980s synth-pop to reset her artistic identity, inspired by Phil Collins, Annie Lennox, Peter Gabriel and Madonna.

trackPair.whatToListenFor: Listen for 1980s pop machinery: programmed drums, bright synthesizers, a bass line that pulses on every beat. Swift moved her songs into the sound Madonna's records had made the standard for dance-pop.

explanation.age13: When Taylor Swift switched from country to pop for '1989', one of the artists she took her sound from was Madonna.
explanation.adult: One of four names Swift gave for the '1989' sound, and the only one on this map. The reinvention itself is the Madonna model as much as the synthesizers.
